title: [FMLA 02] CosineTheorem — Cosine Theorem
summary: Find a side opposite angle A in a triangle (law of cosines).

body.text: Calculator scroll name: CosineTheorem. Find a side opposite angle A in a triangle (law of cosines).
You already know two sides and the angle between them. The cosine theorem finds the third side — the one sitting opposite that angle.

body.caption: Example: b = 5, c = 7, included angle A = 60°. Side a opposite A is about 6.24.

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 0, then 2 (or scroll to the name and EXE)

body.label: Angle unit
body.text: Run in Deg. The included angle must be between 0° and 180°. Wrong SET UP angle unit is the usual source of a mismatch with a textbook answer.
